card.name: Linking words before a country or state name
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of" or "in" right after a government, society or state-level noun, where a country or state name comes next. Also parts of "U.S." and "United States".

modes.label: "of" before a country
modes.description: The word "of" after a government, society or church noun, followed by a nation or region name.
modes.example: Web pages that are archived on the Internet are not subject to the Government<< of>> Canada Web Standards.

modes.label: "in" before nationwide scope
modes.description: The word "in" after a statement of availability or status, leading to "every state" or "the United States".
modes.example: is listed as endangered<< in>> the United States.

modes.label: Inside U.S. or United States
modes.description: Part of the name of the United States itself.
modes.example: is a county in the U<<.S>>. state of California.
